name: @iox/data-model
description: IOX shared data model — schema, types, governance, and tooling.

scripts.generate: npm run types && npm run modules
scripts.generate:check: npm run types:check && npm run modules:check
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec iox-db psql -U iox -d iox_dev
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'pre-commit hooks active'
scripts.test: npm run generate:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
